context: A boss reviews expense policies with his deputy
purpose: Teach: 支払わ/勘定/代行/名目/提唱/容認/容器/同日

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 経費精算の件だが、今期から営業代行費を「研修」の名目で計上するのは、もう容認できない。
lines.en: About expense reports — booking the sales agency fees under 'training' as a category is no longer acceptable.
lines.style: Stern executive tone, clipped sentences, authoritative finality, slight irritation underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。ただ、先方へ支払わなければならない分が今月末に集中しておりまして…。
lines.en: Understood. However, the portion we have to pay to the other party is concentrated at month-end.
lines.style: Deferential office worker, slightly hedging, careful pacing, polite professional register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 支払わないとは言っていない。勘定科目を正しく分けろと言っているんだ。
lines.en: I'm not saying don't pay them. I'm telling you to separate the accounting categories properly.
lines.style: Sharp correction, voice rising mid-sentence, controlled but firm impatience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: では、来週の経理会議で新しい区分を提唱する形でよろしいでしょうか。
lines.en: Then would it be acceptable to put forward the new classification at next week's accounting meeting?
lines.style: Cautious clarification, seeking direction, measured polite tone, slight upward inflection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、それでいい。それと、領収書を入れているあの古い容器、もう廃止しろ。電子化だ。
lines.en: Yes, that's fine. And that old container we've been putting receipts in — scrap it. We're going digital.
lines.style: Brisk approval pivoting to next directive, decisive, no nonsense, brief pause then resumed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。同日付で社内通達を出すよう手配いたします。
lines.en: Certainly. I'll arrange for an internal notice to be issued with that same date.
lines.style: Compliant acknowledgement, businesslike efficiency, polished keigo, swift confirmation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼んだぞ。曖昧な名目での支出は、今後一切認めない方針だからな。
lines.en: I'm counting on you. From now on, our policy is to permit zero spending under vague categories.
lines.style: Closing directive, weighty pause before final phrase, conveying long-term commitment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 肝に銘じます。経理部にも周知徹底するよう、本日中に通達いたします。
lines.en: I'll keep that firmly in mind. I'll notify the accounting department for thorough awareness by end of today.
lines.style: Earnest commitment, slight bow implied in voice, dependable subordinate closure.
